about.title: About Me
about.description: I design and build front-ends for institutional platforms — government portals, municipal sites, and enterprise systems — with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. My focus is on interfaces that hold up under real content and compliance requirements: structured information architecture, accessible UI, and layouts that scale from a public portal to a multi-step financial dashboard.
about.description2: Since 2017 I've shipped 30+ projects across five teams, moving from static HTML/CSS sites to full React and Next.js applications — and I still do both design and front-end, from Figma to production code.
about.summary: Front-end developer and UI designer building government, municipal, and enterprise web platforms for 7+ years.
